description: The ownership gap is insider ownership minus institutional ownership, keeping the sign.

c.request: For each nearby corporate event type (`corpeventprx`) in the sentiment and fundamentals snapshots, with snapshots that have no event type as their own group, what is the average number of analyst coverage reports (`anlycount`), and what is the average gap between insider ownership (`inholdpct`) and institutional ownership (`instownpct`)? Also show each event type's average gap minus the plain average of all the event types' average gaps; this last value can be negative. Averages ignore missing values. Return nothing if that overall average is missing, and don't round anything. The ownership gap is insider ownership minus institutional ownership, keeping the sign.
c.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT corpeventprx AS evt, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gap) AS overall_avg FROM grp) SELECT g.evt, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_gap, g.avg_gap - o.overall_avg AS gap_minus_overall FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL;

b.request: For each `corpeventprx` value in `sentimentandfundamentals` (with snapshots where it is NULL as their own group), return the average `anlycount`, the average of `(inholdpct - instownpct)` with sign kept, and that group's average gap minus the unweighted mean of all groups' average gaps, ignoring NULLs, returning no rows if that overall mean is NULL, and with no rounding
b.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anly, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gap) AS overall_mean FROM g) SELECT g.corpeventprx, g.avg_anly, g.avg_gap, g.avg_gap - m.overall_mean AS gap_minus_overall_mean FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.overall_mean IS NOT NULL;

a.request: For each nearby corporate event type (`corpeventprx`) in the sentiment and fundamentals snapshots, with snapshots that have no event type as their own group, show the event type, the average number of analyst coverage reports (`anlycount`), and the average of insider ownership minus institutional ownership (`inholdpct` − `instownpct`). Keep the sign of that difference, so it is negative when institutional ownership is higher. Also show the event type's average difference minus the plain average of all the event types' average differences; this last value can be negative. Averages ignore missing values. Return nothing if that overall average is missing, and don't round anything.
a.sql:
WITH grp AS (
  SELECT corpeventprx AS event_type,
         AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
         AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_diff
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS overall_avg FROM grp
)
SELECT g.event_type,
       g.avg_anlycount,
       g.avg_diff,
       g.avg_diff - o.overall_avg AS diff_vs_overall
FROM grp g
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL;

d.request: For each nearby corporate event type (`corpeventprx`) in the sentiment and fundamentals snapshots, plus a separate group for snapshots with no event type, what is the average number of analyst coverage reports (`anlycount`) and the average ownership gap, where the gap is insider ownership (`inholdpct`) minus institutional ownership (`instownpct`) with its sign kept? Also show each event type's average gap minus the plain average of all the event types' average gaps, which can be negative. Averages ignore missing values. Return nothing if that overall average is missing, and don't round anything.
d.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gap) AS overall_gap FROM grp) SELECT grp.corpeventprx, grp.avg_anlycount, grp.avg_gap, grp.avg_gap - overall.overall_gap AS gap_vs_overall FROM grp CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.overall_gap IS NOT NULL;
